# MeasureField

## Summary

The y axis of a `ChartCard`: which numeric column is measured and how its values combine per category. `path` is a dot-path into each row; `aggregate` is one of `sum`, `count`, `avg` from `AGGREGATES` in `../utils/chart-spec`. `count` needs no `path` (it counts rows), while `sum` and `avg` require one: `validateChartSpec` reports a missing `path` as a readable fix instead of drawing an empty chart. When the dashboard mints a chart from a dropped file or a web answer and no measure was named, it falls back to `count` so the new tile always renders.

Edit mode shows `path` as text and `aggregate` as a row of pills; embedded shows `aggregate path`.

## Import

```js
import { MeasureField } from '../fields';
```

## Usage

```js
new ChartCard({
  measure: new MeasureField({ path: 'deliveries', aggregate: 'sum' }),
});
```
